# Merge simulation results

In practice, results data can be generated by running the `merge_scores()` function, after specifying the desired parameters. This function searches for `.Rdata` files matching a specific naming pattern and merges the extracted scores into a single data frame.

```{r}
# Exemple of merge simulation
p <- 8
d <- 0.4
mp <- 5

results_dir <- here("results")

merged_simus <- merge_scores(results_dir, p = p, d = d, mp = mp)
```


# Plot performances results

In Figure 1 (effect of the distribution settings), we fix `p`, `d`, and `mp`.

```{r}
p <- 12
d <- 0.4
mp <- 5
results_directory <- here("results")

merged_simus <- merge_scores(results_directory, p = p, d = d, mp = mp)

plot_compare_distributions(merged_simus, results_dir = results_directory, save_figure = TRUE)
```

In Figure 2 (effect of the graph/nodes on the performances), we fix `n`, `k`, `groups` and the pooling strategy `strategy`.

```{r}
n <- 1000
k <- 5
groups <- "Even"
strategy <- "PP"
p <- NULL
s <- NULL
nodedists <- NULL
path_directory <- paste0(path.package("mabnsimstud"),"/results/")

merged_simus <- merge_simulation_results(path_directory = path_directory,n = n, k = k, groups = groups, strategy = strategy)

plot_accuracy_by_graph(merged_simus, metric = "SHD")
```

In Figure 3 (effect of the number of samples per group on the pooling performances), we fix `p`, `s` and `nodedists` and we compare the pooling strategies.

One particularity of the graph is that we merge the number of samples per group in bins (100-125, 200-250, 400-500, 1000).

```{r}
p <- 6
s <- 0.4
nodedists <- "Balanced"
groups <- "Even"
n <- NULL
k <- NULL
strategy <- NULL

path_directory <- paste0(path.package("mabnsimstud"),"/results/")

merged_simus <- merge_simulation_results(path_directory = path_directory,p = p, s = s, nodedists = nodedists, groups = groups)

plot_accuracy_pooling_by_number_samples_per_group(merged_simus, metric = "SHD")
```

In Figure 4 (effect of the model complexity on the pooling performances), we fix `n`, `k` and `groups` and we compare the pooling strategies. 

```{r}
n <- 1000
k <- 5
groups <- "Even"
nodedists <- "Balanced"
p <- NULL
s <- NULL
strategy <- NULL

path_directory <- paste0(path.package("mabnsimstud"),"/results/")

merged_simus <- merge_simulation_results(path_directory = path_directory,n = n, k = k, groups = groups, nodedists=nodedists)

plot_accuracy_pooling_by_complexity(merged_simus, metric = "SHD")
```
